definition: Consolidated external FY2025 recognized revenue
rationale: Original CNY yuan /1,000,000; reconciled to annual p218

definition: FY2025 dedicated equipment revenue, disclosed rounded to 105.27亿元
rationale: Disclosed rounded magnitude; approximately ±0.5 CNY million, not false precision

definition: Unsplit non-equipment mathematical residual: group total minus rounded dedicated-equipment revenue
rationale: Derived subtraction, not a disclosed spares/services amount; business classification and any recurring share unknown; inherits rounded equipment numerator.

definition: FY2025 incremental CMP revenue included in AMEC consolidation
rationale: CMP was acquired in 2026; zero incremental consolidation in FY2025 does NOT mean CMP standalone revenue zero

definition: Dedicated-equipment chambers sold; not all produced or shipped chambers
rationale: Annual physical-sales disclosure; accepted-chamber forecast is a proxy, not a shipment-to-revenue identity proven by the table

definition: Rounded recognized equipment revenue per reported chamber, weighted product/configuration mix proxy
rationale: Not a quoted SKU ASP; rounded numerator limits precision

definition: Assumed chambers achieving revenue recognition in calendar fiscal year; legacy AMEC operations excluding acquired CMP
rationale: Conditional scenario, not a probability band. Global WFE forecast is an outside reference, not copied into AMEC. Customer concentration, client capex, qualification-to-acceptance, price mix and production execution can all change revenue. Base year-on-year unit growth is 30.6%/26.5%/22.0%, starting from 2025 sold 1240; product qualification and domestic process coverage justify a premium to industry benchmark, but no specific capacity ceiling is reported. Low imposes concentrated-client capex/acceptance delays; high requires successful film and packaging ramps. September10 official capacity plan supports expansion direction; 600,000m² current/900,000m² five-year plan and Guangzhou/Chengdu2027H1 commissioning are not converted mechanically into accepted chamber units or guaranteed revenue. Checked annual p219 customerA concentration is39.99% vs22.15%; concentration increases vulnerability to a customer-specific pause. This fact does not reveal the client capex plan or quantify this assumed future chamber path. Company1225482911 p4 delays full HQ/R&D use to2027-12 with some floors already usable. Quantities retain independent conditional assumptions, not an instantaneous capacity conversion. No published chambers/year ceiling supports a mechanical numerical haircut.

definition: Assumed recognized weighted revenue per chamber, mix and discounts included; legacy AMEC operations excluding acquired CMP
rationale: Independent pricing/mix assumption near rounded 2025 proxy 8.4895; low continuing discounts, high richer advanced equipment mix. No segment SKU price or client contract is known.

definition: Analyst-assumed annual recognized non-equipment mathematical residual; no disclosed product/service disaggregation
rationale: Transparent direct_revenue fallback on FY2025 total minus rounded dedicated-equipment revenue (1857.63826811m, rounding inherited). The group describes after-sales support and digital/gas purification activities, but their revenue allocations within this residual are unknown. Retained conditional low/base/high amounts are analyst stress assumptions, not a measured fleet, attach rate, renewal curve or quantified repeat-purchase forecast. No claim that the entire residual is aftermarket; no separate capacity or service-lag transform.
